thread:
elaine (sales): @here just got a 30-page security questionnaire from Galileo (prospect). Looks like CAIQ + some custom questions on encryption, subprocessors, and data residency. Deadline is Friday EOD. Can someone pick this up?

matt (security): I'll triage. Quick Q — is their scope hosted API only or will they ask about private deployment/PIN?

elaine (sales): Hosted API for now. Sales mentioned they might escalate to Private if compliance gaps show up.

omar (solutions): Drop the doc link and I'll start filling the technical sections (network, auth, dataflow). Also need to know if PII will be shared in the POC.

elaine (sales): https://files.redwood/gx/galileo-SQ-2026.pdf (internal access)

apricot-bot: New intake created: ticket SVC-2345 -> security-queue

matt (security): Assigned SVC-2345. First pass notes: encryption at rest is AES-256 via KMS, in-transit TLS1.3. Need confirmation on BYOK/HSM options and key rotation SLA. Also flagging SOC2 evidence request.

jess (legal): I'll start the DPA/subprocessor section. Galileo is specifically asking about subprocessors in EU/UK.

omar (solutions): They want a 2-week eval POC with sample data. I'll draft a POC plan proposing masked or synthetic data and outline retention/erasure flow. If they insist on real data, we need a legal sign-off.

matt (security): Action items checklist:
```
- matt: populate CAIQ sections A1-A9 (security controls, encryption, incident response)
- jess: review & draft DPA/subprocessors responses
- omar: POC runbook + infra diagram + data handling plan
- elaine: coordinate client timeline and update sales contact
```

elaine (sales): Can we have a first draft of answers by Wed 09:00? Client demo is Thu afternoon.

matt (security): Wed 09:00 is tight but doable. I'll get the bulk of CAIQ answers in and mark any items requiring ops/infra input.

omar (solutions): I'll post a simple runbook and a diagram by Tue EOD. If Private deployment gets requested, I'll provide a rough lead-time estimate.

jess (legal): I'll add standard redlined DPA text and call out escalation items for procurement.

apricot-bot: SVC-2345 status -> In progress (owners: matt, jess, omar)

elaine (sales): Thanks — we'll surface blockers in the 15:30 sales huddle. :pray:

matt (security): One potential blocker: they requested a SOC2 report sample and pen-test summary. We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II; needs ops sign-off for distribution. Tagging @leo (ops).

leo (ops): leo (ops): I can prepare redacted SOC2 artifacts by Thu morning. Will coordinate with security for redactions.

omar (solutions): Quick question — do we have a canonical answer for the 'third-party code reviews' field? I can copy/paste if someone points me at the doc.

matt (security): See internal guide: https://intranet/reviews/third-party-code-review-standards (will attach snippet to ticket)

elaine (sales): Please paste final CAIQ/responses into SVC-2345 and update ticket status. I'll let Galileo know we're working it and set expectation for Wed first draft.

(Reaction: :white_check_mark: by elaine (sales))
